patterns.fast-slow: Node a,b; a.next=&b; check(!hasCycle(&a)); b.next=&a; check(hasCycle(&a));
patterns.linked-reversal: Node a{1},b{2}; a.next=&b; Node* r=reverseList(&a); check(r==&b && r->next==&a && a.next==nullptr); check(reverseList(nullptr)==nullptr);
patterns.backtracking: auto actual=subsets({1,2}); sort(actual.begin(),actual.end()); vector<vector<int>> expected{{},{1},{2},{1,2}}; sort(expected.begin(),expected.end()); check(actual==expected); check(subsets({})==vector<vector<int>>({{}}));
patterns.trie: Trie t; t.insert("apple"); check(t.startsWith("app") && !t.search("app")); t.insert("app"); check(t.search("app"));
